stance_rationale: PD22 reject direction is numerically plausible, but the forge package is not checklist-complete: DSR/Harvey 5-spec, lockbox/OOS chart evidence, and artifact-path/schedule lineage are missing or inconsistent. Revise before treating this as final QEPM forge evidence rather than an exploratory full-period comparison.

critical_concerns.description: Harvey/DSR gate is absent: package reports a Diebold-Mariano t_NW only, but no CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 alpha t_NW, no DSR, no candidates_tried total, and no baseline DSR post-penalty.

Lockbox/OOS visual audit is missing for PD22: no equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, or oos_zoom_chart.png exists under backtest_result_pd22, and the package relies on 'lockbox 폐기' rather than showing a lockbox-marker/frozen-extension audit.

Artifact lineage is inconsistent: the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_001 alpha_scores/covariance path and qepm/mailbox/.../weights.csv are absent; stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001 exists, but its weights.csv has 155 dates ending 2023-11 while PD22 holdings use 184 dates through 2026-04.

Turnover is a hard fail, not just a design weakness: PD22 mean one-way monthly turnover is 52.39%, annualized one-way is 628.70% and round-trip equivalent is 1257.39%, exceeding the <600% turnover hard constraint under either strict round-trip reading or the reported one-way metric.

Baseline comparison is only partially fair: S4 v2 is recomputed on the same 184m period, but PD18 is cited on 256m, PD20B aligned omits CVaR, and none of the baselines include the required same DSR penalty.

PD22 inherits unresolved alpha PIT-C13/C14 remediation while using extended alpha_scores through 2026-04; the package does not quantify whether Z_Score_Aligned-only rebuild changes cross-universe ranks or the rejection margin.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function audit passes: alpha/risk/optimization md5 values match start/end and current files.
PD22 is not a single-snapshot backtest: holdings.csv has 184 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2026-04-01, 20 holdings per date, sum_w=1, max_w=0.05.
Stage B alpha_scores.parquet has 62,916 rows, 184 sig_dates, and 770 tickers; covariance.parquet is PSD with condition number about 8.81.
The core rejection is directionally supported: PD22 SR 0.7426, MDD -33.60%, CVaR95 -11.16% versus same-period S4 v2 SR 1.8258, MDD -12.63%, CVaR95 -4.61%.
Cross-universe diagnostic supports the structural thesis: top20 slots are 98.5% KR stocks on average, so sleeve hedging is effectively lost.
unresolved_disputes: Whether lockbox-scope.md/Q-Lead operational override formally supersedes RF-F3 for forge critic output.
Whether the turnover hard cap is one-way annualized or round-trip annualized; PD22 fails one-way anyway at 628.70%.
Which schedule artifact is authoritative for PD22: missing mailbox weights.csv, stage B 155-date sleeve weights.csv, or PD22 184-date holdings.csv.
The correct candidates_tried total for DSR penalty across alpha, optimizer, and forge variants.
Whether alpha PIT-C13/C14 remediation could materially alter the 184-date cross-universe rank history.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that the mandate to run '프로즌없이 전 기간' allows a full-period operational backtest to substitute for the forge role's lockbox/OOS, DSR, and 5-spec verification requirements.
rebuttal_required: Provide Harvey 5-spec CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 table with alpha_monthly, t_NW, and DSR for PD22 and same-period baselines.
Generate PD22 equity_curve.png with lockbox marker, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png or formally cite the governance waiver that disables RF-F3/RF-F8.
Publish an authoritative PD22 schedule artifact covering 184 sig_dates through 2026-04, or explicitly map holdings.csv as the schedule replacement.
State turnover hurdle interpretation and label PD22 as hard-fail under the chosen convention.
Quantify PD22 sensitivity to the pending alpha PIT-C13/C14 Z_Score_Aligned-only remediation.
rationalization_red_flags: structurally optimal subject to the realized 5-sleeve panel
TC drag ... negligible vs delta SR
CVaR cap infeasible / structural to KR equity baseline
industry standard sampling for discovery WT audit

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I directionally accept that PD22 should not be admitted, but I do not accept the package as verification-complete because required forge statistical, lockbox/chart, and artifact-lineage checks are incomplete.

walk-forward 시계열 충분 (>=60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? PD22 holdings yes, but weights.csv lineage is inconsistent.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? No PD22 chart evidence found.
baseline 비교가 same-period · same-cost · same-DSR-penalty인가? Same-period S4 yes, same-DSR no.
